_how: Notes taken on 2026-10-22 from each hiset.org state page (PSI). The pages could not be downloaded with a script (HTTP 403); they were read one by one and the figures copied as printed. Where a page contradicts itself, both readings are noted.

_general.scores: https://hiset.org/get-your-scores/ : "The passing score for each subtest is 8 out of 20." / "An combined score of at least 45 out of 100 for all five subtests is an overall HiSET passing score." / "you must score at least 2 out of 6 on the essay portion of the Language Arts – Writing subtest." College and career readiness: at least 15 of 20 on a subtest and at least 4 on the essay.
_general.subtests: https://hiset.org/about-hiset/ : Mathematics 90 min, Science 80 min, Social Studies 70 min, Language Arts Reading 65 min (80 min in Spanish), Language Arts Writing 120 min (multiple choice and an essay); English or Spanish; paper, computer or at home where the state allows.
_general.retakes: State pages: "You pay the full test fee only on the first and fourth attempt." Retakes 2 and 3 cost only the test center fee or the at-home online proctor fee.
_general.list: https://hiset.org/get-started/state-requirements/ lists 26 US states plus territories; New Jersey (since June 1, 2023) and West Virginia (since August 1, 2024) no longer offer HiSET.

CA: Paper/computer $34 per subtest ($20 test fee, $14 center fee), at home $43; one-time state fee of $20 at first booking; fee waiver for those who qualify; 18 or older (17 in listed cases); California residency required. Expected totals $190 / $235.
CO: Paper $35.50, computer $32.50, at home $48.50 per subtest (state fee $7.50 included); page total $177.50 for both formats; 17 without conditions, 16 with waiver; no residency.
GA: Computer $34 ($18 + $8 center + $8 state), at home $49; total $170 / $245; vouchers through the Georgia State Program; 18; no residency.
HI: Paper $28 ($18 + $10 center), computer $18 ($18 + $0), at home $41; the page prints an expected total of $190 for computer, which does not match 5 x $18; 18; no residency.
IL: Paper/computer $26 ($18 + $8), at home $41; totals $130 / $205; 30 days of residency; 17 with withdrawal proof.
IN: No amount for paper/computer: "Testing fees for paper and computer tests are determined by the test center." "Indiana provides test code vouchers for fees." Live online proctored test suspended since July 1, 2025 except approved cases. 18; 30 days residency.
IA: Paper/computer $18, at home $41 ($18 + $23); totals $90 / $205; no residency; under 18 needs drop form or non-enrollment proof.
LA: Paper/computer $24 per subtest, at home $41, State Admin Fee $10 "one time annual fee"; totals $130 / $215; 19 without documents; no residency.
ME: Paper/computer $60 ($45 test + $15 center); "There is no fee to take the HiSET exam if you are a resident of Maine."; 17; no residency required to test.
MA: No fee table; "the Commonwealth of Massachusetts pays for a candidate's first HiSET test in each subject plus two retakes per subject"; online proctored not offered; 18; Massachusetts address.
MI: Paper/computer $26 ($18 + $8), at home $41; $30 one-time annual state fee; totals $160 / $235; 18; no residency.
MN: Paper/computer $28, at home $41; promo MNHISET8: $8 off each subject the first time, Minnesota residents, capped at $40; 19 (17-18 waiver); no residency. Page prints $170 for paper and $140 for computer.
MS: No amounts; "Effective July 1, 2026, the State of Mississippi will pay for a candidate's HiSET tests." with promo codes per subtest and two retests per subtest; 18; residency required.
MO: Paper/computer $22 ($15 test + $7 center), at home $32.50 ($15 + $17.50 proctor); State Admin Fee $10, annual, at first subtest; totals $120 / $172.50; 17; Missouri address.
MT: Paper/computer up to $28 ($18 + up to $10 center); at home discontinued September 1, 2025; total up to $120 printed; 19; residency required.
NV: Paper/computer $23 ($18 + up to $5), at home $41; totals $115 / $205; 18; residency required.
NH: Paper/computer $28 ($18 + $10), at home $51 ($18 + $23 + $10 state); totals $140 / $225; 18; residency required.
NM: Paper $18, computer $26, at home $41; totals $90 / $130 / $205; vouchers through the State Office or providers; 18; no residency.
NC: Paper/computer $18, at home $41; totals $90 / $205; 18; no residency; retakes within 12 months pay only the center fee.
OH: Paper/computer $26 ($18 + $8), at home $41; "$80 voucher codes" for paper or computer; Ohio residency; 16-18 with conditions.
OK: Paper/computer $33 ($20.50 + $7.50 + $5 state), at home $48.50; totals $165 / $242.50; 18; no residency.
PA: Paper/computer $26, at home $41; the Commonwealth covers up to five subtests for residents (promo PAFreeHiSET); 18; residency required.
TN: Paper/computer $23, at home $41; HiSET Voucher Program through local Adult Education "covers all costs associated with the exams"; 18 (17 with waiver); residency required for the voucher.
WY: Paper/computer $18 plus a test center fee that varies, at home $41; totals $90 / $205 printed; no residency; under 16 may not test.
